title_zh: GPT-4V(ision) 是通用网页智能体——前提是能够落地(接地)
one_line: SeeAct splits GPT-4V web acting into screenshot-based action generation and separate element grounding; offline Mind2Web plus a small live-website check show grounding is the bottleneck.
